# Segmentics POS

> Segmentics is a lightning-fast, progressive web app (PWA) billing and point-of-sale system designed specifically for small shops.

Segmentics provides small business owners with an easy-to-use, offline-capable checkout experience. The system is designed to run natively on mobile devices and tablets, featuring real-time data syncing, local queuing during internet outages, and direct integration with lightweight shop hardware. 

## Core Pages
- [Home & FAQ](https://segmentics.vercel.app/): Main landing page, system overview, hardware setup, and frequently asked questions.
- [About](https://segmentics.vercel.app/about): Information about the Segmentics platform.
- [Pricing](https://segmentics.vercel.app/pricing): Subscription tiers for independent retailers.
- [Demo](https://segmentics.vercel.app/demo): Interactive showcase of the POS capabilities.
